WITH per_order_net_rates AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    AVG(feerate) - AVG(rebrate) AS order_net_rate
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
scope_order_nets AS (
  SELECT
    u.acctscope,
    pon.order_net_rate
  FROM orders o
  JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  JOIN per_order_net_rates pon ON o.recordvault = pon.orderslink
),
scope_stats AS (
  SELECT
    acctscope,
    AVG(order_net_rate) AS scope_avg_net_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM scope_order_nets
  GROUP BY acctscope
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(scope_avg_net_rate) AS overall_avg_net_rate
  FROM scope_stats
)
SELECT
  s.acctscope,
  s.scope_avg_net_rate,
  s.order_count,
  s.scope_avg_net_rate - o.overall_avg_net_rate AS diff_from_overall
FROM scope_stats s
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
ORDER BY s.acctscope;

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average reference is the weighted average of per-scope averages (overall average from all orders), giving more weight to scopes with more orders, rather than the simple unweighted average of the per-scope averages.
